question: What is the name of the new Water Management and Policy Centre that was inaugurated by the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, Prof. K. VijayRaghavan in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AquaMAP.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AquaMAP** is the name of the **new Water Management and Policy Centre** that was recently inaugurated in India by **Prof. K. VijayRaghavan,** the **Principal Scientific Adviser** to the Government of India.
 
• The centre aims to work towards the **sustainable management **of water resources in the country and develop policies and strategies to address water-related challenges.
 
• The centre will also focus on research, capacity building, and collaboration with stakeholders to promote **water conservation, reuse, and recycling.**
 
• The inauguration of AquaMAP is a significant step towards achieving the **United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal 6, **which aims to ensure availability and **sustainable management of water** and **sanitation for all.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Water management** refers to the regulation and **distribution of water resources **with the aim of minimizing harm to individuals and property while optimizing their useful life.
 
• **Rainwater collection** is the main method used by the Water Management program to **augment groundwater** and restore depleted subterranean aquifers. 
 
• **Droughts and abus**e are making water, a once-abundant natural resource, a more **valuable commodity.**
